title: 胸腔內科
intro: 氣喘、COPD、間質性肺病、肺癌診斷與支氣管鏡介入。 本科包含原創虛擬病例與另標示的課程模板；請依選單切換。
introEn: Asthma, COPD, interstitial lung disease, lung cancer diagnosis and bronchoscopic intervention. This specialty includes original fictional cases and separately labelled course templates.

procedures.title: 肺炎影像與全身狀況一起看
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：73 歲女性咳嗽、發燒且比平常混亂。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 73-year-old woman has cough, fever and new confusion. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 虛擬紀錄：胸片右下肺局部陰影、呼吸 30 次/分，並有新意識混亂。
stages.evidenceEn: Simulated findings: right-lower-zone opacity, respiratory rate 30/min and new confusion.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 結合病況評估嚴重度
choices.en: Assess severity with the clinical condition

choices.zh: 只按陰影大小決定是否住院
choices.en: Decide admission solely from opacity size

choices.zh: 高齡混亂屬正常，不需處理
choices.en: Confusion in old age is normal and needs no review

stages.reason: 影像不能取代全身評估。
stages.reasonEn: Imaging does not replace systemic assessment.
stages.pitfall: 只看圖片會低估不穩定病人。
stages.pitfallEn: The image alone may underestimate an unstable patient.

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 初期照護後仍發燒、呼吸負擔增加。
stages.evidenceEn: Fever persists and breathing effort rises after initial care.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 只重拍胸片而不看生命徵象
choices.en: Repeat radiographs without checking vital signs

choices.zh: 重評病因與併發症
choices.en: Reassess causes and complications

choices.zh: 照原計畫不再追蹤任何變化
choices.en: Keep the plan without reviewing any change

stages.reason: 反應不佳需要重新思考。
stages.pitfall: 忽略惡化可能錯失併發症。

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 呼吸與意識趨勢、影像、檢驗待報及治療反應。
stages.evidenceEn: Breathing and cognition trends, imaging, pending tests and treatment response.
stages.question: 影像有陰影，但意識和呼吸仍在惡化；接班應優先保留什麼？
stages.questionEn: Imaging shows an opacity, but cognition and breathing worsen. What should handover prioritise?

choices.zh: 按陰影大小分級
choices.en: Grade by opacity size

choices.zh: 只交班影像位置
choices.en: Hand over opacity location alone

choices.zh: 病況趨勢與治療反應重評
choices.en: Clinical trends and reassessment of treatment response

stages.reason: 肺炎影像與病人狀態需一起解讀，影像不能代表全部嚴重度。
stages.reasonEn: Pneumonia imaging and clinical condition are interpreted together; imaging alone does not grade all severity.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：肺炎影像與全身狀況一起看。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Pneumonia: image and patient together.

procedures.title: 氣喘仍喘：先看吸入器怎麼用
procedures.titleEn: Persistent asthma symptoms: watch inhaler use
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：26 歲女性經常夜咳，自述每天有使用吸入器。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 26-year-old woman reports frequent night cough despite daily inhaler use. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 她只能說出吸入器顏色，操作示範有漏步。
stages.evidenceEn: She names inhalers by colour and misses steps in a demonstration.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 依顏色推定所有吸入器功能相同
choices.en: Assume all similarly coloured inhalers have the same role

choices.zh: 核對藥品與實際技巧
choices.en: Check medicines and actual technique

choices.zh: 只看自述有用藥就立即加藥
choices.en: Escalate solely because she reports using treatment

stages.reason: 技巧與實際使用影響效果。
stages.reasonEn: Technique and actual use affect delivery.
stages.pitfall: 沒查技巧會把無效吸入當藥物失敗。
stages.pitfallEn: Unreviewed technique can mimic drug failure.

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 症狀在打掃工作日較明顯。
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 只計算藥量而不問工作環境
choices.en: Count doses without asking about work

choices.zh: 只要有工作就判定職業性氣喘
choices.en: Employment alone proves occupational asthma

choices.zh: 評估暴露及症狀變化
choices.en: Assess exposure and symptom patterns

stages.reason: 時間關聯是線索而非確診。
stages.reasonEn: Timing is a clue, not a diagnosis.
stages.pitfall: 忽略暴露會留下可改善因素。
stages.pitfallEn: Ignoring exposure leaves modifiable factors unexplored.

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 症狀控制、吸入技巧、依從性、工作暴露與個人行動計畫。
stages.evidenceEn: Control, technique, adherence, work exposure and a personalised action plan.
stages.question: 吸入器操作有漏步且症狀與工作日相關；後續門診最需要哪組資料？
stages.questionEn: Inhaler steps are missed and symptoms relate to workdays. What matters for follow-up?

choices.zh: 吸入技巧核對及工作症狀時間線
choices.en: Technique review and a work-symptom timeline

choices.zh: 先標藥物無效，升級後再查技巧暴露
choices.en: Label medication ineffective and increase treatment before reviewing technique or workplace exposure

choices.zh: 只記錄吸入器顏色
choices.en: Record inhaler colour alone

stages.reason: 治療反應受使用技巧與暴露影響，不能直接從症狀推定藥物無效。
stages.reasonEn: Technique and exposure affect response; symptoms alone do not prove treatment failure.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：氣喘仍喘：先看吸入器怎麼用。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Persistent asthma symptoms: watch inhaler use.

procedures.title: 長期抽菸與喘：確認阻塞而非猜測
procedures.titleEn: Smoking and breathlessness: confirm rather than assume
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：65 歲男性長期抽菸，走路喘且晨咳。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 65-year-old smoker has exertional breathlessness and morning cough. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 胸片有肺氣腫特徵，但尚未完成肺功能。
stages.evidenceEn: Radiography suggests emphysema; spirometry is not yet completed.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 有抽菸史即可確診所有呼吸問題
choices.en: Smoking history diagnoses every respiratory complaint

choices.zh: 一張胸片就能取代全部肺功能
choices.en: One radiograph replaces all lung-function testing

choices.zh: 結合症狀與肺功能確認
choices.en: Confirm using symptoms and spirometry

stages.reason: 影像與肺功能提供不同資訊。
stages.reasonEn: Imaging and physiology provide different information.
stages.pitfall: 只靠影像容易混淆其他喘的原因。
stages.pitfallEn: Imaging alone may miss other causes of breathlessness.

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: 肺功能品質不佳，呼氣未達測試要求。
stages.evidenceEn: The spirometry effort fails quality requirements.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 先檢視品質再判讀
choices.en: Check test quality before interpretation

choices.zh: 直接用不合格數據分期與追蹤
choices.en: Stage and monitor using invalid measurements

choices.zh: 只挑最接近預期結果的一次
choices.en: Select whichever result matches expectations

stages.reason: 可靠判讀需要可靠量測。
stages.pitfall: 錯誤基準會影響後續比較。

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 暴露、症狀、合格肺功能、吸入治療與戒菸復健計畫。
stages.evidenceEn: Exposure, symptoms, valid spirometry, inhaled therapy and smoking-cessation and rehabilitation plans.
stages.question: 肺功能呼氣品質未達要求；交班應如何表達診斷確定度？
stages.questionEn: Spirometry does not meet quality requirements. How should diagnostic certainty be handed over?

choices.zh: 胸片加不合格肺功能即可確診
choices.en: Treat emphysema on imaging plus poor-quality spirometry as confirmed diagnostic evidence

choices.zh: 先改善檢查品質再確認阻塞
choices.en: Improve test quality before confirming obstruction

choices.zh: 只記錄測得數字
choices.en: Record measured values alone

stages.reason: 品質不合格不能當成可靠生理量測，需把限制和重測安排交接。
stages.reasonEn: A poor-quality test is not a reliable physiological measurement; transfer its limits and repeat-test plan.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：長期抽菸與喘：確認阻塞而非猜測。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Smoking and breathlessness: confirm rather than assume.

procedures.title: 胸痛與喘：肺栓塞的機率思考
procedures.titleEn: Chest pain and dyspnoea: probability before a label
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：42 歲女性長途旅行後突然呼吸困難，單側小腿腫。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 42-year-old woman develops sudden dyspnoea after travel with unilateral calf swelling. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

stages.title: 初步線索
stages.evidence: 胸片沒有明顯異常，但症狀突然出現。
stages.evidenceEn: The radiograph is unrevealing despite abrupt symptoms.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 評估肺栓塞可能性
choices.en: Assess pulmonary embolism probability

choices.zh: 胸片正常就排除所有肺栓塞
choices.en: A normal radiograph excludes all emboli

choices.zh: 只以焦慮解釋突發症狀
choices.en: Explain sudden symptoms solely as anxiety

stages.reason: 胸片不能單獨排除肺栓塞。
stages.pitfall: 錯誤安心會延誤適當檢查。

stages.title: 證據交叉核對
stages.evidence: D-dimer 升高；她最近還接受過手術。
stages.evidenceEn: D-dimer is elevated and she recently had surgery.
stages.question: 根據目前證據，最合理的判斷或下一步是？
stages.questionEn: Given the evidence, which interpretation or next step is best?

choices.zh: 忽略手術史只比較單一數字
choices.en: Ignore surgery and compare one number

choices.zh: 結合機率選後續檢查
choices.en: Select further tests using clinical probability

choices.zh: 升高即證明肺動脈有血栓
choices.en: An elevation proves pulmonary arterial thrombus

stages.reasonEn: D-dimer is not a confirmatory test.
stages.pitfall: 把篩檢當確診會造成錯誤決策。
stages.pitfallEn: Treating a screening test as diagnostic misleads.

stages.title: 交班與追蹤
stages.evidence: 危險因子、機率評估、檢驗與影像結果、循環及出血風險。
stages.evidenceEn: Risk factors, probability, tests and imaging, circulation and bleeding risk.
stages.question: 胸片無異常、D-dimer升高且近期手術；交班該保留什麼？
stages.questionEn: Chest X-ray is normal, D-dimer elevated and surgery recent. What belongs in handover?

choices.zh: D-dimer即確診
choices.en: D-dimer confirms it

choices.zh: 只交班胸片正常
choices.en: Hand over a normal chest X-ray alone

choices.zh: 臨床機率、影像安排與循環風險
choices.en: Clinical probability, imaging plans and circulatory risk

stages.reason: 陽性D-dimer並不確診；機率、後續檢查與安全因素仍需整合。
stages.reasonEn: A positive D-dimer does not confirm the diagnosis; probability, further tests and safety factors remain relevant.
stages.pitfall: 若漏掉上述未決問題，接班可能錯估本案風險：胸痛與喘：肺栓塞的機率思考。
stages.pitfallEn: Omitting these unresolved issues can distort the next team’s assessment of Chest pain and dyspnoea: probability before a label.

procedures.title: 肋膜積液：找原因再談處理
procedures.titleEn: Pleural effusion: ask why before how
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：69 歲男性單側積液，最近體重減輕。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 69-year-old man has unilateral pleural fluid and recent weight loss. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 乾咳與細裂音：辨識間質性肺病
procedures.titleEn: Dry cough and crackles: consider interstitial disease
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：60 歲女性逐漸活動喘，有鳥類飼養及關節症狀。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 60-year-old woman develops exertional dyspnoea with bird exposure and joint symptoms. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 肺結節不等於癌症
procedures.titleEn: A pulmonary nodule is not automatically cancer
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：56 歲女性健康檢查發現肺結節，沒有舊片在手邊。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 56-year-old woman has an incidental nodule without prior images available. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 白天嗜睡：睡眠呼吸問題
procedures.titleEn: Daytime sleepiness: investigate breathing during sleep
procedures.patient: 虛擬個案：48 歲男性打鼾，伴侶看過呼吸停頓，白天開車會打瞌睡。 本單元為教學情境，不是臨床操作規範。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional case: A 48-year-old man snores, has witnessed pauses and feels sleepy while driving. Educational reasoning, not an operational clinical protocol.

procedures.title: 咳血：量的估計與呼吸影響一起看
procedures.titleEn: Haemoptysis: volume estimates and respiratory impact
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：長期咳嗽的患者今天咳出鮮血，同時更喘；家屬對出血量的估計差異很大。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A patient with chronic cough now produces fresh blood and becomes more breathless; family estimates of the volume differ.

procedures.title: 突然單側胸痛：先看變化速度
procedures.titleEn: Sudden unilateral chest pain: assess the rate of change
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：26 歲患者突然一側胸痛與喘，過去曾有氣胸。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 26-year-old has abrupt unilateral chest pain and breathlessness with a previous pneumothorax.

procedures.title: 離開工作場所就改善的咳喘
procedures.titleEn: Cough and dyspnoea that improve away from work
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：42 歲患者近月咳喘，休假改善，回到有粉塵與鳥類接觸的工作場所後復發。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A 42-year-old has cough and dyspnoea that improve on leave and recur at a workplace with dust and birds.

procedures.title: 反覆膿痰：檢體與既往培養的價值
procedures.titleEn: Recurrent purulent sputum: samples and prior cultures
procedures.category: 進階病例：證據與時間線
procedures.categoryEn: Extended cases: evidence and time course
procedures.patient: 虛擬教學個案：支氣管擴張患者近期痰量變多、活動耐受下降，曾有多次不同培養結果。
procedures.patientEn: Fictional teaching case: A patient with bronchiectasis has more sputum and reduced exercise tolerance after several different prior culture results.

procedures.title: 軟式支氣管鏡
procedures.patient: 依課程「軟式支氣管鏡」設定的虛擬情境：氣道解剖、支氣管肺泡灌洗、切片與併發症。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Flexible bronchoscopy": Airway anatomy, bronchoalveolar lavage, biopsy and complications. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 2：支氣管肺泡灌洗
關鍵要素 3：切片與併發症

procedures.patient: 依課程「導航支氣管鏡與機器人支氣管鏡」設定的虛擬情境：周邊肺結節的電磁導航與機器人平台。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Navigational and robotic bronchoscopy": Electromagnetic navigation and robotic platforms for peripheral nodules. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 1：周邊肺結節的…

procedures.patient: 依課程「肺功能檢查判讀」設定的虛擬情境：FEV1/FVC、阻塞／侷限型、DLCO 與支氣管擴張試驗。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Pulmonary function test interpretation": FEV1/FVC, obstructive vs restrictive patterns, DLCO and bronchodilator response. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

procedures.patient: 依課程「氣喘階梯治療（GINA）」設定的虛擬情境：ICS-formoterol、生物製劑與急性發作處置。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Asthma stepwise therapy": ICS-formoterol, biologics and exacerbation management. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 2：生物製劑與急…

procedures.title: COPD 治療（GOLD）
procedures.patient: 依課程「COPD 治療（GOLD）」設定的虛擬情境：ABE 分組、LAMA/LABA、肺復健與氧氣治療。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。
procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "COPD management": ABE groups, LAMA/LABA, rehabilitation and oxygen therapy. The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.

stations.zh: 關鍵要素 3：肺復健與氧氣…

procedures.title: 間質性肺病與抗纖維化
procedures.patient: 依課程「間質性肺病與抗纖維化」設定的虛擬情境：HRCT 型態、多專科討論、nintedanib／pirfenidone。 本程序板以該課程的工序為站點；僅作辨識、判斷與交班教學，不提供真人操作參數。

procedures.patientEn: Virtual scenario for "Central sleep apnea": Recognize absent respiratory effort; Compare heart failure drug and altitude factors; Interpret sleep-test limitations The stations are this course’s own steps; recognition, decision and handover teaching only — no parameters for real procedures.
